Commands are registered through LOCALIZED_COMMAND_LABELS and re-synced (label + availability + run) on every render, then workspace.refreshToolbar() re-renders the shared toolbar; readiness reasons come from COMMAND_REASON_KEYS so blocked titles are localised too.
